one_line: Bengali reformer who used Sanskrit learning, petitions, and print to challenge sati during the early 19th‑century debates in Calcutta and London.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s to early 50s, medium height, slender but dignified build.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, light brown Bengali complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed black mustache, thoughtful large anime-style eyes with small round spectacles, default expression calm, serious, slightly compassionate.
appearance.hair: Black hair cut short and tidy under a deep mustard-yellow silk turban wrapped low and firm, with a narrow maroon border around the base.
appearance.costume: Long white cotton Bengali-style jama (knee-length robe with fitted sleeves and side tie) over a slightly off-white under-tunic, paired with ankle-length plain white cotton dhoti wrapped in the Bengali style with a neat front pleat; over this he wears a rich indigo-blue shawl with a subtle woven paisley border in maroon and gold draped over his left shoulder and around his torso; simple brown leather sandals on his feet and minimal jewelry limited to a single thin gold ring on his right hand.
appearance.signature: A rolled parchment petition tied with a red ribbon held firmly in his right hand, with a worn brown leather-bound book (representing shastra and legal texts) tucked under his left arm.

ref_desc: Rammohun Roy is a late-middle-aged Bengali man with an oval light-brown face, short black hair under a mustard-yellow turban, white jama and dhoti, indigo shawl, brown sandals, spectacles, and he carries a rolled petition and a leather-bound book in indigo, mustard, maroon, white, and brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Rammohun Roy: a late-middle-aged Bengali man with an oval light-brown face, large serious eyes behind small round spectacles, straight nose, and a neat black mustache. His short black hair is mostly covered by a deep mustard-yellow silk turban wrapped low and firm, with a narrow maroon border around its base. He wears a knee-length white cotton jama with fitted sleeves and side tie over an off-white under-tunic, and an ankle-length plain white cotton dhoti wrapped in the Bengali style with a clean front pleat. An indigo-blue shawl with a subtle maroon-and-gold woven paisley border is draped from his left shoulder across his torso, giving a dignified, scholarly look. His feet are in simple brown leather sandals, and the only jewelry is a thin gold ring on his right hand. In his right hand he clasps a rolled parchment petition tied with a red ribbon, while under his left arm he tucks a worn brown leather-bound book, symbolizing scriptures and legal texts. Use a clean, historically grounded shonen-anime style with crisp lines, focusing on consistency of the turban, shawl, dhoti, and petition; dominant colors should be white, indigo blue, mustard yellow, maroon, and brown.
